Fixed. The bug was that `@StandardException`'s generated constructors delegate with bare `null` literals, e.g. `this(null, null)`, which javac can't disambiguate from an `@AllArgsConstructor(Foo, Bar)` constructor when the class has exactly two non-primitive fields.

The fix (mirroring upstream lombok PR #3674) casts the delegated arguments so only the intended constructor matches:

- `src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleStandardException.java` — no-arg and message-only constructors now pass `this((String) null, (Throwable) null)` / `this(message, (Throwable) null)` via `maker.TypeCast(genJavaLangTypeRef(...))`.
- `src/core/lombok/eclipse/handlers/HandleStandardException.java` — same fix using `CastExpression` + `generateQualifiedTypeRef`.

- `ant test.instance` (TestWithDelombok): 416 tests, 0 failures; `StandardExceptionWithConstructor` and `StandardExceptions` pass.
- `ant test.javacCurrent`: 0 failures, StandardException tests pass across delombok/idempotent suites.
- `ant test.ecj19`: 0 failures, ecj expectations match.
- Manual repro: delombok of `@StandardException @AllArgsConstructor` class with two non-primitive fields now generates casts, and the previously ambiguous call site `new Failure("ouch", cause)` compiles.
